about: The timesheet tour's document (M33 U7): the ledger pack and one paycheck, for September, from a made-up weekend job. Synthetic and round: two days at 60.00 an hour, 8 hours on the 7th and 6.5 on the 14th, are 870.00, the paycheck's gross; its lines take 70.00, so its own claim (net) proves. A plan, Everyday, sends the whole net to spending, so the Paychecks screen shows nothing red that is not the story (M33 F7). The tour declares the timesheet itself and types the days; nothing of it is in this file. scripts/make-demo-document.mjs writes this into .demo/timesheet.emd.
